limits: Both native frames have their printed lengths and consist entirely of observed ADFGVX coordinates; no repair, fill, exclusion, insertion or key change is used.
The substantial bodies already occur in the frozen earlier OCR screen. The new source reading fixes three OCR masks in C; D has the same decoded labels as that earlier screen.
5280625, 2078, 6829 and 109 are literal under the published full key. No external numerical interpretation or digit reassignment is applied.
IS, MUV, ASRM1, E.H. and S.M.St.Pers. remain unexpanded. The header spelling UNG is retained.
ROESLER occurs twice, with an X between occurrences. Its grammatical attachment is not resolved by the editorial punctuation. HOENIGSCHMID and HITTMER are not externally identified.
